def mocked_fetch_url(*args, **kwargs):
    print(args)
    if args[1] == 'https://api.meraki.com/api/v0/404':
        info = {'status': 404,
                'msg': '404 - Page is missing',
                'url': 'https://api.meraki.com/api/v0/404',
